result:
Both test classes compile and pass (39 tests total: 24 for `AnnotationUtilsAgentTest`, 15 for `AbstractReflectionAgentTest`).

Summary of coverage:
- **`AnnotationUtilsAgentTest`** (`src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/AnnotationUtilsAgentTest.java`): `equals()` (null handling, same-instance, different annotation types, equivalent/non-equivalent members, primitive array length mismatch, nested-annotation arrays), `hashCode()` (matches JDK's real hash, consistency, `IllegalStateException` on a null member via a hand-built dynamic proxy), `toString()` (format, separators, nested rendering), `isValidAnnotationMemberType()` (null, primitives, enum/annotation/String/Class, arrays, invalid types), the deprecated public constructor, and `NullPointerException` from `Validate.notNull` when a proxy's `annotationType()` returns null.
- **`AbstractReflectionAgentTest`** (`src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/AbstractReflectionAgentTest.java`): `getForceAccessible()` (default, true/false/garbage system property, restored after each test), static and instance `setAccessible()` (null object, already-accessible short-circuit, force vs. no-force on a private field), `AbstractBuilder` chaining/propagation, and the package-private registry helpers `isRegistered`/`register`/`unregister`/`toRegisterPair`.
